steps.do: Create lena and sam under Accounts (password cookbook08-lab-passphrase), create a workspace with the top bar +, and add both as Reviewer under Project access. The server must list lena in CALIBER_APPROVER_USERS.
The manifest's deploy gate names a test set (incident-cases). Import it before that test set exists: Import, type a name, Choose file incident-commander.workflow.json, Validate dependencies.
steps.see: Preflight needs attention and is not visible in this workspace: the import is refused until the test set exists.

steps.do: Press + New Test Set, type the name from the manifest (incident-cases), owner @lab08, Create, open it and press Import from file; choose incident-cases.jsonl and press Import 41 rows.
steps.see: incident-cases.jsonl: 41 rows ready to import. then 41 active examples; the gateway incident's row shows "answer": "sev1 rollback".

steps.do: Import again with the same file and name, Validate dependencies, then Import as new.
steps.see: Preflight passed; the editor opens with severity_table, action_table, join, triage_router and review in the outline.

steps.do: Press Validate, then Preview, paste the IN01 incident and press Run Preview, and open the summarize step. Unlike a Python Code workflow, this one previews.
steps.see: The toolbar says Valid.; the preview is completed and the summarize step shows sev1 rollback.
The toolbar says Published. The alpha UI has no Deployments or Promotions tab: the staging and gated prod aliases, the deploy gate and rollback are API only.

steps.do: Open Run Monitor, paste an incident ({"incident": {...}}) and press Run. Run IN06 (healthy staging), then IN01 (gateway regression after a deploy). Then press Approve on the IN01 run as the same account.
steps.see: IN06 completes with RECOMMENDATION and sev4 monitor. IN01 stops at waiting_approval; Approve as the starter shows a second person must decide.

steps.do: Sign in as lena, choose the workspace, open Workflows, the workflow and its Runs tab, select the run that shows Awaiting approval, press Approve, then Resume.
steps.see: The run's output contains ROLLBACK_APPROVED and the sev1 rollback verdict. (Evaluations can also score a Workflow version as the subject, at most 20 examples per run; with the simulated provider it answers 400 evaluation requires a real LLM provider.)

steps.do: On Versions press Restore as draft on v1 (a new draft, v2). Double-click action_table in the outline; in Configuration (JSON) change the value of the error_rate condition of the rule rollback-recent-high-risk-deploy-errors from 0.05 to 0.5 and click outside the box. Save, Validate, Preview the IN23 incident and open summarize; then Publish (v2) and, on Versions, compare v1 (Base) with v2 (Compare).
steps.see: IN23 now reads sev2 escalate_human (v1: sev2 rollback); the comparison shows one modified node, action_table. The API script's prod gate refuses this version (pass rate 0.9512); the alpha UI has no gate.

steps.do: Press Restore as draft on v1 again (v3), Preview IN23, then Publish.
steps.see: IN23 reads sev2 rollback again; Versions lists v1, v2 and v3.

steps.do: Pick the test set, What to score Workflow version, paste the v1 version id (WFV-… from its editor URL), untick Exact match and Token F1, press Run. A workflow run scores at most 20 examples.
steps.see: Simulated: evaluation requires a real LLM provider. Real: a completed row 20/20; its detail says graded 20 of 41 active examples.

steps.where: Agent resources › Agents, then Workflows › (workflow) › Calibrate
steps.do: New agent (any id, an experiment id, a name) and Register agent; then on the workflow press Calibrate, pick the agent and Start Calibration.
steps.see: The dataset badge reads 41 examples; the run ends rejected with a Structural score badge (and Simulated evaluation on a simulated stack).
